arguments.message:
Billing models of fourteen practices, from their lab statements, in /workspace/practice_billing_models.xlsx.

The statements are 24 spreadsheets in the Drive: the 23 whose titles begin with one of the fourteen practice names
(Johnson & Associates 4, Over The Moon 2, Empowered Goddess 4, Des Moines 2, Elke Barnes 2, one each for the other
nine), plus j8lghvv51re0e787xpdvnpaj, the raw export titled with the practice ID that the four empty Empowered Goddess
statements carry as their tab name. Johnson & Associates' own raw export is in the trash and is left out. Together they
hold 37 billing rows, every one on the Billing sheet with its file id, order id and TRUE for client bill (17 rows) or
FALSE for cash pay (20 rows).

The Summary counts practices, not billing rows:
- billed_practices: 12 (every practice except Des Moines and Elke Barnes)
- cash_pay_practices: 7 (Johnson & Associates, Over The Moon, Canyon Midwifery, Kellie Botts, Authentic Birth, Joyful
  Heart, Kindred Space)
- client_bill_practices: 7 (Johnson & Associates, Over The Moon, BirthStone, Birthing Hues, Jamii, Profound Birth,
  Empowered Goddess through its raw export)
- switched_practices: 2 (Johnson & Associates and Over The Moon, each billed cash pay first and client bill later)
- silent_practices: 2 (Des Moines and Elke Barnes: every one of their statements is empty)
